g.text: 1) How can we ensure strong consistency for bids?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Online auctions are a classic example of the dealing with contention pattern.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - This requires careful coordination using techniques like optimistic concurrency control, row locking,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: or caching strategies to manage competition for the same resource.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Bad Solution: Row Locking with Bids Query

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -- Lock all existing bid rows for this auction

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -- Get current max (from the locked rows)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_bid FROM bids

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -- Insert if the new bid beats the current max

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: INSERT INTO bids (auction_id, user_id, amount, bid_time)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - This doesn't actually prevent concurrent inserts.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - As no of bids per auction grows, you're locking more and more rows for each new bid. This creates a bottleneck with

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: increasing latency and poor user experience.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - You want to use row locking sparingly and with optimizations to ensure that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a) you lock as few rows as possible and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: b) you lock rows for as short of a duration as possible. We don't respect either of these principles here.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Cache maxBid for auction in Redis

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Read maxBid for given auction from Redis

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - If neew bid higher, update cache with new maxBid

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Write the bid to db with status of accepted

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: There's no clean way to make Redis and a relational database transactionally consistent.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Redis doesn't support distributed transaction protocols like two-phase commit

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Best Sol: Cache maxBid in Auction Table

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Lock the auction row for the given auction (just one row)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Read the max bid for the given auction from the Auction table.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Write the bid to the database with a status of accepted or rejected.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Update the max bid in the Auction table if the new bid is higher.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - We now only lock a single row for short duration.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Optimistic Concurrency Control is ideal for our system because bid conflicts are relatively rare.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Read the auction row and get the current max bid (this is what is referred to as the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Validate that the new bid is higher than the max bid

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Try to update the auction row, but only if the max bid hasn't changed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - This approach avoid locks while manintaing consistency, occasional retry when conflicts do occur.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) How can we ensure that the system is fault tolerant and durable?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Durable Storage (if Bid Service, crashes, bid is safely stored and won't be lost)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Kafka guarantees message ordering within a single partition. By partitioning our topic by auctionId, all bids for the same

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: auction land on the same partition and are processed in the order they were received. This is important for fairness - if two

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: users bid the same amount, we want to ensure the first bid wins.

g.text: - Conflicts are expensive to unwind. If retrying means redoing a lot of computation, or if a failed write has
